HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   B. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

2. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

3. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.

   C. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.

5. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat National Security as rumours only.
   C. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)

   A. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.

   D. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.

   A. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.

   D. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   A. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.

   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

16. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Political developments in independent Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Internal conflicts in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
